question:

25º

 
 
 

 
 
Saturday

 
 
 
55º

 
 
 

 
 
Sunday

What is the difference between the temperature recorded on Monday and Tuesday together and the temperature recorded on Friday and Saturday together?
solution:
Calculation:

Now, the difference between the temperature recorded on Monday and Tuesday together and the temperature recorded on Friday and Saturday together

⇒ (25 + 55) - (20 + 45)

⇒ 15°

**∴ The difference between the temperature recorded on Monday and Tuesday together and the temperature recorded on Friday and Saturday together is 15°.**
